headline: A brilliant listing at the peak of advent calendar season, but part of its ad budget is chasing shoppers who want squishy, chocolate and LEGO calendars, while its #1 rankings have no ad cover.

points.title: Stop paying for other kinds of advent calendar
points.detail: The calendar has sponsored placements on 'squishy advent calendar 2026' (176k/mo, sponsored #4), chocolate, LEGO, dumpling and men's advent calendar searches, where it ranks organically at #55-104 or not at all. In peak season those clicks are expensive and go to shoppers who want a different product.
evidence: dumpling advent calendar 2026: 45,400/mo, sponsored #11, not ranked
Source: Jungle Scout keywords by ASIN

points.title: Protect the #1 rankings with top-of-search ads
points.detail: It ranks #1 organically for 'advent calendar 2026 for women' (58.5k/mo), 'beauty advent calendar 2026' (27k/mo) and 'girls advent calendar 2026' (17k/mo) with no ad, so on mobile a competitor's ad can sit above it. Cheap exact-match ads hold the top of the page through December.
evidence: advent calendar 2026 for women: 58,537/mo, organic #1, no sponsored rank
beauty advent calendar 2026: 26,967/mo, organic #1, no sponsored rank
girls advent calendar 2026: 17,153/mo, organic #1, no sponsored rank

points.title: Push 'advent calendar' from #5 to the top
points.detail: 'Advent calendar' gets 220k searches a month and the calendar already ranks #5 organically with no ad behind it. That's the biggest single term to win in the next eight weeks.
evidence: advent calendar: 220,256/mo, organic #5, no sponsored rank, CPC ~£0.22

points.title: Cover the 'w7' brand search
points.detail: Julep Eyeshadow takes a sponsored slot on 'w7' searches and there's no W7 ad there. A brand campaign is cheap insurance in the busiest weeks of the year.
evidence: 'w7': Julep Eyeshadow sponsored at position 10; no W7 sponsored placement (DataForSEO, Amazon UK)

hero_actions.B0GTRFKFV5: Add negatives for squishy, chocolate, LEGO, dumpling and men's calendar searches, and put that budget into top-of-search on its #1 terms and 'advent calendar'.

content_note: The listing itself is excellent on mobile and desktop: 2000px zoomable images, a brand video, phone-friendly A+ and 5,300+ reviews at 4.7★.
ad_strategy_summary: Move spend from other kinds of calendar to the terms it already ranks for: defend the #1 rankings, push 'advent calendar' from #5, and cover the brand search.
amc_hypotheses: Advent calendars are bought as gifts, so many buyers will be new to W7. AMC would show how many go on to buy W7 make-up afterwards.
amc_questions: How many calendar buyers are new to W7?
What do they buy next, and when?
